html:
Iraq is the country of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, the old land of Mesopotamia, with its capital at Baghdad. It became independent in 1932 after the British mandate. The map shows it from 1945.

Its first state was a monarchy under the Hashemite family, closely tied to Britain. In the 14 July Revolution of 1958, army officers killed the young king and declared a republic. Coups followed until the Ba'ath Party took lasting power in 1968. Oil, nationalised in 1972, paid for rapid growth.

Saddam Hussein became president in 1979 and ruled by terror. He invaded Iran in 1980, starting the Iran-Iraq War, which lasted eight years and killed hundreds of thousands. He used poison gas against Iranian troops and against Iraqi Kurds. In 1990 he invaded Kuwait and was driven out in the Gulf War. UN sanctions followed.

In 2003 a US-led invasion, the Iraq War, removed Saddam. Years of sectarian civil war followed, and in 2014 the Islamic State seized much of the north and west before being defeated in 2017.
sum: Iraq is the country of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, the old land of Mesopotamia, with its capital at Baghdad. It became independent in 1932 after the British mandate. The map shows it from 1945.
